evaluation_semantics: adaptive development only because POS_2952166 was already consumed by v4.5 visual-prompt evaluation; no independent-holdout claim

model.purpose: frozen vision-language encoder for fine-grained material crop classification

glass: a close-up photograph of a high-voltage glass insulator
a green or blue-tinted glass suspension insulator
an electrical insulator made of glass
ceramic_family: a close-up photograph of a high-voltage porcelain insulator
a brown glazed ceramic suspension insulator
an electrical insulator made of porcelain or ceramic

prototype_rule: L2-normalise each SigLIP2 pooled embedding; average the three reference embeddings per material class; L2-normalise the class mean.
hybrid_rule: For each evaluation crop, compute cosine similarity to the text class prototype and image class prototype, z-normalise each two-class score vector within the crop, then average the two score vectors equally.
decision_rule: argmax over the two material classes; no threshold tuning
display_score: two-class softmax of method scores for visual readability only; explicitly labelled relative/un-calibrated score
selection_rule: Because this is adaptive development, the best method may be selected for the next cycle, but no v4.6 result may be described as independent material holdout performance.
claim_boundary: Source-assisted material labels; ceramic_family intentionally broader than porcelain; no condition/defect/corrosion/failure/safety claim.
